description: Keystone: CNT-13 (w1) directly, but it is the only door to the organizer half of CNT-04 (w2), CNT-05 (w2), CNT-14 (w2) — ~23% of the area on one screen — PLUS the CNT-02 (w3) rescue (the portal never shows an uploaded filename; after upload the speaker sees a checkmark and no evidence of what they uploaded). NO MIGRATION: every presign already mints a new attachment row (unique r2_key), old rows persist, speaker_tasks.attachment_id is the latest-pointer. (1) src/lib/files/versions.ts: listVersionsFor(db, ownerType, ownerId) with ROW_NUMBER version numbers and is_latest DERIVED as attachments.id = speaker_tasks.attachment_id — derive, never store. (2) FileVersions component mounted in the portal task row ('slides.pdf - v2 of 2 - uploaded ...' + prior versions each downloadable) and in the library. Export both — the speaker-files ticket consumes them. (3) /files route, sidebar label EXACTLY 'Files' (the spec enumerates the agent's guesses). GET .../files: attachments->speaker_tasks->submissions/people; filename, session, speaker, uploaded, version count, size; row expands to versions. 'Copy link' per row over existing publicMediaUrl with the honest caveat (unauthenticated capability URL). (4) Skip the per-session Files tab (rubric forgives). Human lens: list EXPECTED deliverables too — one row per speaker x file-task, filled or empty, chaseable — the screen an AV lead runs the show from. Full spec: section T-F1. Register rows 26,28 + CNT-02 rescue.
title: Files library and version lists
